source_title: Exploitation and Sanitization of Hidden Data in PDF Files (Adhatarao & Lauradoux)
evidence_summary: Crawled 39,664 PDFs from 75 security agencies in 47 countries; large shares exposed producer tool (76%) and OS (42%), some author names, emails and file paths; few agencies sanitised and most sanitisation was weak.
limitations: Dataset is security agencies' public PDFs from 2021, not general users; shows prevalence, not willingness to use a tool.

source_title: Security agencies leak sensitive data by failing to sanitize PDF files
evidence_summary: Press coverage of EV-001; only a handful of 75 agencies removed all sensitive data.
limitations: Restates EV-001.

evidence_summary: Some Epstein-related PDFs released by the US Justice Department had black bars over text that remained selectable and copyable.
limitations: Commentary post summarising news reports; not an official DOJ statement.

source_title: Story Beyond the Eye: Glyph Positions Break PDF Text Redaction / Bland et al. arXiv 2206.02285
evidence_summary: Academic study found thousands of non-excising redactions in US court documents and reported that some popular PDF redaction tools did not remove text; also showed glyph positions can leak redacted words.
limitations: US court corpus; numbers taken from search summary, paper not read in full in this pass.

source_title: x-ray: find bad redactions in PDFs
evidence_summary: Open-source Python library/CLI that finds rectangles drawn over text; supports only that most common failure type; used internally on court collections.
limitations: Python/CLI only - not usable by non-technical staff; detects only one failure class.

evidence_summary: Law professor reports another failed redaction seen in a recent filing by a large law firm; recurring series of such posts since at least 2020.
limitations: Anecdotal; firm not identified in the summary.

source_title: PDF without Adobe 17: Unredacting Manafort's documents and recovering PDF versions
evidence_summary: Explains how incremental saving keeps earlier versions inside a PDF and how they can be recovered by truncating at an earlier %%EOF.
limitations: Technical explainer; old but mechanism unchanged.

source_title: An Examination of the Redaction Functionality of Adobe Acrobat Pro DC 2017
evidence_summary: Government test motivated by public incidents; per search summary, remnants of redacted content were recoverable from PDFs made with some other tools (e.g., CutePDF, LibreOffice Writer).
limitations: Read via search summary only; tool versions are old.

source_title: Introducing HAR Sanitizer: secure HAR sharing
evidence_summary: Released after the Okta support-system breach where a stolen HAR file exposed session tokens; tool strips session cookies and JWTs and runs client-side.
limitations: Vendor blog; incident details come from Cloudflare's view.

evidence_summary: Repository archived (read-only) on 2026-06-22; 253 stars at observation.
limitations: Whether the hosted har-sanitizer.pages.dev still works was not checked.

evidence_summary: Free metadata remover for photos and PDFs, states processing in the browser; one localized page lists 10 files / 10 MB limits.
limitations: Launch date unknown; FAQ on upload behaviour not read; feature depth (revisions, annotations) not stated.

evidence_summary: Drive add-on cleaning JPEG/PNG/WebP/PDF/DOCX/XLSX/PPTX in the browser; free 50 files/month, Pro $8/month; listing does not mention revisions, tracked changes or hidden sheets.
limitations: Install count not shown; depth of cleaning unverified.

evidence_summary: Free client-side remover for JPG/PNG/WebP/HEIC/PDF/DOCX/XLSX; 0 likes/reviews at observation.
limitations: Listing text is vendor-provided.

evidence_summary: Claims local processing 'whenever possible'; broad format list incl. video/audio; mentions only document properties for PDF/Office; no verification step stated.
limitations: Marketing page; not tested.

evidence_summary: Client-side metadata stripper for photos/video/audio/docs incl. C2PA; HN post had 3 points and 0 comments.
limitations: Low engagement suggests weak HN pull for generic metadata removers; one data point.

evidence_summary: Popular open-source desktop cleaner; its docs say original PDF metadata is not truly removed because ExifTool writes reversible updates. Third-party listing shows ~2.3k stars (undated).
limitations: Star count from an undated AlternativeTo snapshot.

source_title: Hide markup and comments in Word / Document Inspector guidance
evidence_summary: 'No Markup' view only hides tracked changes temporarily; Microsoft recommends Document Inspector before sharing.
limitations: Built-in desktop tool exists - a strong free alternative for Office users who know about it.

evidence_summary: Describes a public company embarrassed by tracked changes discovered in a press release.
limitations: Old anecdote.

evidence_summary: Secondary guides report Signal and WhatsApp photo sends strip EXIF, while email, iMessage and 'send as file/document' keep it.
limitations: Vendor content; not tested here.

evidence_summary: Community recommendation page for metadata/data redaction tools (ExifTool, MAT2 type tools) - an existing destination where privacy users look for tools.
limitations: Page content not fetched in full; inclusion criteria unknown.

source_title: PII redaction extensions for ChatGPT (Rescriber; Paste Redactor; Velum Lite; PrivacyScrubber; Offsend)
evidence_summary: Many extensions already redact PII/secrets before prompts, several claiming on-device processing; Rescriber runs a local NER model.
limitations: User counts/reviews not collected.

source_title: Samsung bans staff AI use after ChatGPT data leak
evidence_summary: Samsung engineers pasted source code and meeting notes into ChatGPT; company restricted generative AI use.
limitations: Single famous incident; does not show individuals seek a website tool.

evidence_summary: Many MCP setups store long-lived API keys in plaintext config files, sometimes world-readable.
limitations: Describes local storage risk rather than sharing behaviour.

source_title: How hyperconnected AI development creates multi-system secret sprawl
evidence_summary: Reports 1,785 valid secrets found in AI development files on public GitHub, incl. mcp.json and claude_desktop_config.json.
limitations: Number originates from a vendor study not read here.

source_title: MCP config scanners (mcp-scan; mcp-guard; mcp-security-scanner; GhostHunt)
evidence_summary: Several CLI scanners already check MCP configs for secrets.
limitations: Quality and adoption unknown.

source_title: Supabase RLS scanners and prevalence study
publisher: Level Up Coding (Medium) + dev.to/Product Hunt listings
evidence_summary: Study reports 146 of 777 public repos (18.8%) exposed a table at some commit; many indie scanners (vibe-shield; LeakScope; Vibe App Scanner; Ship Safe) launched.
limitations: Self-published study; scanners are promotional.

source_title: Splinter lint 0013 rls_disabled_in_public / Supabase Security Retro 2025
evidence_summary: Official linter flags RLS disabled as ERROR; Supabase emails owners about tables created without RLS.
limitations: None significant.

source_title: axesCheck - check a PDF for accessibility online
evidence_summary: Free web version of PAC (upload-based), checks PDF/UA and machine-checkable WCAG A/AA; PAC desktop is Windows-only.
limitations: Upload limits unknown.

evidence_summary: EAA obligations from 2025-06-28 with transition rules for older content; drives document-accessibility interest.
limitations: Vendor interpretations differ on document scope.

evidence_summary: Removes route points within a chosen distance of start/finish for FIT files and warns if the route still passes near them.
limitations: FIT only; processing location not verified.

source_title: Sanitizing GPX files for public sharing / OSM GPSBabel filters / Komoot privacy zones
evidence_summary: Users resort to scripts or GPSBabel radius filters to remove home points; Komoot says privacy zones do not change route data; no online radius-based GPX tool found in this pass.
limitations: Absence of evidence is not proof no tool exists.

evidence_summary: Strava hides start/end on its own pages; controls apply to display.
limitations: Whether Strava's exported file honours hiding was not confirmed.

source_title: Screenshot redaction extensions (RedactShot; PixelCloak; Image Redactor; SafeCast; Redacted)
evidence_summary: Numerous local screenshot redaction extensions exist.
limitations: Few reviews; quality unknown.

evidence_summary: The official GIB viewer is a downloaded desktop program requiring Java 1.8; account-based services offer viewing; no free install-free browser viewer confirmed in this pass.
limitations: Vendor blogs; Turkish search demand unknown.

source_title: Removing XSLT for a more secure browser
evidence_summary: Chrome plan: XSLT stops working on Stable in Chrome 158 (scheduled 2026-11-17), with a wasm polyfill offered; Firefox/WebKit also plan removal.
limitations: Whether 158 shipped on schedule not confirmed.

evidence_summary: Multiple free repo-to-prompt tools exist; repo2txt (browser-local) shows ~1.8k stars.
limitations: Star counts for Gitingest/Repomix not collected.

evidence_summary: actionlint already runs in the browser via WebAssembly.
limitations: None.

source_title: ReactPDF audit tool and redaction-verification guides
evidence_summary: A small audit tool claims to check whether redactions worked; guides tell users to verify manually by selecting/searching text and inspecting metadata.
limitations: ReactPDF pricing/processing location unknown.

evidence_summary: Test found that many photo sharing/storage sites failed to strip metadata.
limitations: Dated; platform behaviour may have changed.

source_title: Local EXIF removers (W3Schools; imageupload.io; t.ly; ezgif)
evidence_summary: Many free, local image-only EXIF removers exist, including on very high-authority domains.
limitations: None.

evidence_summary: Free tool whose copy says files are uploaded, cleaned and then deleted.
limitations: Based on search summary of page copy.

evidence_summary: Asks users to upload or drag files; server-side processing implied.
limitations: Processing location inferred from copy.

evidence_summary: Implemented: JPEG/PNG/WebP lossless metadata strip; PDF revisions/Info/XMP/annotations/attachments/JS/forms + single-revision rewrite; DOCX/XLSX/PPTX hidden-content reporting + property cleaning; HAR/JSON/log/.env secret redaction; app re-scans cleaned copy. Does not detect text under PDF boxes; no HEIC; single file at a time; no Anthropic/OpenAI key patterns.
limitations: Read from code outline (grep) not full execution.

evidence_summary: Records repeated AdSense 'low-value content' rejection, commodity tool inventory, withdrawn off-topic finance blog, and earlier 5-candidate comparison.
limitations: Internal; no traffic data available.

source_title: Adobe Acrobat online: remove metadata from PDF
evidence_summary: Adobe ranks with a content page for PDF metadata removal queries.
limitations: Processing location of Adobe online tools assumed upload per pivot doc; not re-verified.
